page_title: SEV 4-0 OVI | Sevilla v Oviedo 14/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' Oviedo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

90+2' Sevilla slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

89' 4 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball low into the middle of the goal and makes it 4:0. Aaron Escandell was helpless.
86' Substitution. Joan Jordan (Sevilla) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Lucien Agoume walks off.
86' Close! Alex Fores (Real Oviedo) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
85' Aaron Escandell displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
85' 12:4 – the total goal attempt statistics.
83' David Carmo (Real Oviedo) is ejected after receiving a second yellow card and inevitably the red one. He can take an early bath.
82' David Carmo (Real Oviedo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Isidro Diaz had an easy-decision to make.
79' Salomon Rondon comes off the pitch to be replaced by Pablo Agudin (Real Oviedo).
78' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
78' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sevilla.
77' A substitution has been made. Batista Mendy is replaced by Miguel Sierra (Sevilla).
77' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Alexis Sanchez walks off the pitch to be replaced by Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla).
70' Luis Carrion has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Javi Lopez replacing Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo).
69' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sevilla.
67' Akor Adams (Sevilla) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
66' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

65' Akor Adams (Sevilla) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper. Sevilla will take a corner kick.
65' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sevilla.
61' Substitution. Josip Brekalo (Real Oviedo) has come on for Alberto Reina.
59' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
54' Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
51' 3 - 0 Goal! Akor Adams plays a pass to the feet of Batista Mendy (Sevilla), and he shoots into the bottom right corner from inside the box. It's 3:0.
49' Oviedo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
47' Sevilla take a short corner kick.
46' The game is over for Djibril Sow. Manuel Bueno Sebastian (Sevilla) comes on for the second half.
46' Luis Carrion makes a half-time substitution. Alex Fores (Real Oviedo) comes on in place of Ilyas Chaira.
46' Today's match ends for Lucas Ahijado who will be replaced by Dani Calvo (Real Oviedo).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+8' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+7' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
45+7' It looks like Fabio Cardoso (Sevilla) saw red with that tackle. Isidro Diaz won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
45+5' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) is caught offside!
45+4' What a big chance! Akor Adams (Sevilla) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
45+3' Lucas Ahijado (Real Oviedo) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley well wide of the right post.
45+2' Oviedo fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
44' The total number of attempts is 5:1.
42' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
42' The foul by Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) was seen by Isidro Diaz who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
39' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
34' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
34' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
32' The ball is cleared after Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
32' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Fabio Cardoso (Sevilla). Isidro Diaz saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
28' A cross from Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
26' Akor Adams (Sevilla) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
25' Sevilla hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
22' 2 - 0 Djibril Sow (Sevilla) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
21' Ilyas Chaira (Real Oviedo) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball has crossed the sideline. Sevilla are taking a throw-in.
20' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
20' Castrin (Sevilla) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Oviedo.
19' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Oviedo, play can continue.
15' Referee Isidro Diaz makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Oviedo. Let’s see what happens!
14' That looked a certain handball by Batista Mendy (Sevilla) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
14' It seemed like Santiago Colombatto (Real Oviedo) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
13' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Isidro Diaz blows for a foul.
12' Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
11' Sevilla players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
11' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
8' Oviedo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
8' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Haissem Hassan (Real Oviedo). The referee blows his whistle, Oviedo are awarded a corner kick.
7' Rahim Alhassane (Real Oviedo) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
4' 1 - 0 Akor Adams (Sevilla) is released by Lucien Agoume, he surges into the box and smashes a great shot into the net after a one-on-one with the goalkeeper.

3' Salomon Rondon (Real Oviedo) reacts superbly inside the box to get first to the rebound. From about the penalty spot he produces a header down towards the middle of the net, but Odysseas Vlachodimos pulls off a magnificent save to keep the ball out of the net.
2' Flag goes up against Akor Adams (Sevilla) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' The match has just started.
Sevilla will kick the game off.
Isidro Diaz will officiate today.
